A '''galaxy''' was home to a [[Unidentified googly-eyed species|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings. At one point, a group of members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] traveled aboard a [[fathership]] on a tour of [[The galaxy/Legends|another galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that was fought there between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. At the end of the voyage, the fathership was scheduled to travel back to the [[Alien/Legends|aliens']] home [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] so that they could attend an event known as the [[World Series]].<ref name="TRG1">{{WEGCite|story=The Night Has a Thousand Eyes|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
